title: Marcos emphasizes kapwa and interconnectivity at ASEAN Dinner
summary: President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. and First Lady Louise Araneta-Marcos hosted leaders of ASEAN member-nations and external partners around a Filipino table on Monday evening.

blocks.text: President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. and First Lady Louise Araneta-Marcos hosted leaders of ASEAN member-nations and external partners around a Filipino table on Monday evening.

"The strength of ASEAN goes beyond agendas and agreements. It is sustained by relationships, mutual trust, and the recognition that the peace, prosperity, and well-being of its Member States are interconnected," the Presidential Communications Office (PCO) said.

President Marcos and the First Lady welcomed the guests to the Gala Dinner, "where the President highlighted kapwa, a Filipino value that embodies seeing ourselves in others and recognizing our shared identity, common humanity, and interconnected lives."

President Marcos also recalled that the regional bloc, for 60 years, worked on "building consultation, cooperation, and trust, emphasizing that its strength comes from generations of leaders and partners who have worked together for regional peace, prosperity, and resilience."
The PCO said the evening provided an opportunity for leaders to enjoy Filipino food, music, and hospitality. — BAP, GMA News
